# Walkie Talkie App for HackRF PortaPack

A simple walkie-talkie application with earphone button PTT support.

## Features
- Separate TX/RX frequency control
- Same frequency mode (simplex)
- Volume control
- On-screen PTT button
- **Earphone button PTT support** - press button on earphone cable to transmit!

## Usage
1. Set TX frequency (what you transmit on)
2. Set RX frequency (what you listen to) or check "Same as TX"
3. Adjust volume
4. Press earphone button or screen PTT to talk
5. Release to listen

## Hardware
Requires earphone with inline PTT button connected to GPIO0 (check your PortaPack model for exact pin)
